cultural.vision_reason: This 1873 cabinet card is a documentary photograph of three Modoc men (identified as "Captain Jack's capturers"), including traditional dress elements like the embroidered/beaded cloth tied at the waist of the man on the left, alongside period Western clothing worn by the group.

physical.title: photographic print (black and white); cabinet card
physical.classification: photographic print (black and white); cabinet card
physical.summary:
Photograph (black and white) cabinet card; portrait of Donald McKay and Captain Jack's capturers; three Modoc men sitting in a row; the man on the far left is wearing a shirt, trousers and an embroidered piece of cloth tied around his waist; Donald McKay sitting in the centre, is wearing a checked shirt, and a pair of trousers; the man on the far right has his hair crimped, and is wearing a shirt, and a pair of trousers; United States of America. 
Albumen print
